name: NET Dollar
oneLiner: NET Dollar is Cloudflare’s planned USD-backed stablecoin for automated web payments; legal issuer and deployment details remain unpublished.
collateral: Pre-launch: Cloudflare promises each NET Dollar will be fully collateralized by one U.S. dollar. Reserve allocation, custodians, segregation, holder priority and independent token-specific assurance remain undisclosed.
pegMechanism: Planned 1:1 USD-backed payment instrument for automated agent transactions and interoperable web commerce. The FAQ explains stablecoin redemption generically; NET-specific holder eligibility and redemption minimums, fees, timing and capacity are unpublished.
launchPhaseDetail: Cloudflare announced NET Dollar on September 25, 2025 for agentic web commerce. The product FAQ inspected 2026-10-02 still says it will be made available soon, without a dated launch window. CoinGecko verifies the net-dollar identity and NET symbol but publishes no current price, market cap or deployments. NET is provider-confirmed, not an issuer-confirmed ticker. The exact legal issuer, chains and holder terms are undisclosed.

milestones.title: Cloudflare announces NET Dollar for agentic commerce
milestones.description: The announcement commits to a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin for automated payments by agents, developers and creators.
